mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_repo_perm (tenant_id, agent_version_id, repo_id, perm_level, allowed_branch_patterns) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{repoId}, #{permLevel}, #{allowedBranchPatterns})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_repo_perm WHERE agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} AND repo_id = #{repoId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS agentId, a.name AS agentName, av.id AS agentVersionId, av.version_no AS versionNo, CASE WHEN a.online_version_id = av.id THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'EDITING' END AS refType FROM agent_repo_perm p JOIN agent_version av ON av.id = p.agent_version_id JOIN agent a ON a.id = av.agent_id WHERE p.repo_id = #{repoId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND av.is_deleted = 0 AND (a.online_version_id = av.id OR a.editing_version_id = av.id) ORDER BY a.id, av.version_no
